parameters.query: INSERT INTO bot_pausa (telefone, pausado_ate, motivo) VALUES ($1, now() + make_interval(mins => $2::int), 'atendente respondeu') ON CONFLICT (telefone) DO UPDATE SET pausado_ate = EXCLUDED.pausado_ate, motivo = EXCLUDED.motivo, atualizado_em = now()
INSERT INTO n8n_chat_memoria (session_id, message) SELECT $1, x FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) x
INSERT INTO fila_mensagens (telefone, msg_id, texto) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (msg_id) DO NOTHING

WITH eh_ultima AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM fila_mensagens
  WHERE telefone = $1 AND NOT processada
  HAVING max(id) = (SELECT id FROM fila_mensagens WHERE msg_id = $2)
), marcadas AS (
  UPDATE fila_mensagens SET processada = true
  WHERE telefone = $1 AND NOT processada AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eh_ultima)
  RETURNING id, texto
)
SELECT string_agg(texto, E'\n' ORDER BY id) AS texto FROM marcadas HAVING count(*) > 0

WITH antes AS (SELECT atualizado_em FROM cliente WHERE telefone = $1),
pausa AS (SELECT * FROM bot_pausa WHERE telefone = $1),
fim_pausa AS (DELETE FROM bot_pausa WHERE telefone = $1 AND pausado_ate <= now() RETURNING 1),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO cliente (telefone, jid, nome) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
  ON CONFLICT (telefone) DO UPDATE SET jid = EXCLUDED.jid,
    nome = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.nome, ''), cliente.nome), atualizado_em = now()
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT up.*,
  COALESCE((SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - atualizado_em) / 86400) FROM antes), 0)::int AS dias_sem_contato,
  COALESCE((SELECT pausado_ate > now() FROM pausa), false) AS pausado,
  COALESCE((SELECT pausado_ate > now() AND motivo <> 'atendente respondeu'
            AND COALESCE(alertado_em, atualizado_em) < now() - interval '10 minutes' FROM pausa), false) AS realertar,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fim_pausa) AS voltou_de_pausa,
  COALESCE(up.apagar_solicitado_em > now() - interval '15 minutes', false) AS apagar_pendente,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bloqueados WHERE telefone_hash = md5(split_part($1, '#', 1))) AS bloqueado
FROM up

WITH a AS (DELETE FROM cliente WHERE telefone = $1), b AS (DELETE FROM bot_pausa WHERE telefone = $1),
c AS (DELETE FROM fila_mensagens WHERE telefone = $1), d AS (DELETE FROM n8n_chat_memoria WHERE session_id = $1),
e AS (DELETE FROM bot_enviadas WHERE telefone = $1), f AS (DELETE FROM bloqueados WHERE telefone_hash = md5(split_part($1, '#', 1)))
SELECT 1 AS ok

parameters.query:
WITH u AS (
  UPDATE cliente SET etapa = $2, perfil = NULLIF($3, ''), cnpj = NULLIF($4, ''), empresa = NULLIF($5, ''),
    tentativas = $6::int, link_enviado = $7::boolean, turnos_sem_link = $8::int, notas = NULLIF($9, ''), pendente = NULLIF($10, ''),
    segmento = NULLIF($11, ''), turnos_desde_link = $13::int, sem_android = $14::boolean, ultimo_alerta = NULLIF($15, ''),
    ultimo_alerta_em = CASE WHEN $16::boolean THEN now() ELSE ultimo_alerta_em END, apagar_solicitado_em = CASE WHEN $12::boolean THEN now() ELSE apagar_solicitado_em END,
    atualizado_em = now()
  WHERE telefone = $1 RETURNING etapa
)
INSERT INTO bloqueados (telefone_hash) SELECT md5(split_part($1, '#', 1)) FROM u WHERE etapa = 'bloqueado' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO bot_enviadas (msg_id, telefone) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO n8n_chat_memoria (session_id, message) SELECT $1, x FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) x

WITH a AS (DELETE FROM n8n_chat_memoria m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cliente c WHERE c.telefone = m.session_id AND c.atualizado_em >= now() - interval '90 days') RETURNING 1),
b AS (DELETE FROM fila_mensagens WHERE recebida_em < now() - interval '7 days' RETURNING 1),
c AS (DELETE FROM bot_enviadas WHERE enviado_em < now() - interval '30 days' RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM a) AS conversas, (SELECT count(*) FROM b) AS fila, (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS enviadas
